Data Processing & Privacy
Assessment Submission
Company: DigitalCart Technologies Ltd.
Industry: E-commerce / Digital Commerce
Operating Region: European Union
Assessment Type: GDPR Compliance Assessment
1. Company Overview
DigitalCart Technologies Ltd. operates an online e-commerce platform through
its website and mobile applications. Customers can create accounts, browse
products, place orders, make payments, and receive personalised product
recommendations.
The company operates primarily in EU member states and has approximately
180 employees.
DigitalCart acts as the controller for personal data collected through its website
and mobile applications.
2. Customer Account Information
When a customer creates an account, the following information is collected:
Full name
Email address
Telephone number
Date of birth
Gender
Billing address
Shipping address
Account username
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 

Password
Customers are required to provide their name, email address, telephone
number, billing address and shipping address. Date of birth and gender are
collected during account registration.
3. Order and Transaction Information
When a customer places an order, the following information is recorded:
Customer ID
Products purchased
Quantity
Order value
Date and time of purchase
Shipping address
Billing address
Payment method
Order status
Refund information
The company does not directly store complete credit/debit card numbers.
Payment transactions are processed through an external payment service
provider.
4. Website Behaviour
DigitalCart records customer interactions with its website and mobile
application. The following information may be collected:
Pages visited
Products viewed
Search queries
Time spent on pages
Products added to cart
Products removed from cart
Abandoned carts
Clicks on advertisements

Product categories viewed
Login timest

amps
Device information
IP address
Browser information
This information is associated with the customer's account where the customer
is logged in.
5. Customer Profiling
DigitalCart maintains a customer profile for registered users. The profile is
generated using information such as:
Purchase history
Purchase frequency
Average order value
Products viewed
Product categories viewed
Search behaviour
Cart activity
Website interaction frequency
The company uses automated software to assign customers to marketing
segments. Examples of segments include:
High-value customers
Regular customers
Occasional customers
Low-engagement customers
These segments are used to personalise product recommendations and
promotional communications.

6. Product Recommendations
DigitalCart uses automated algorithms to recommend products to customers.
Recommendations may be based on:
Previous purchases
Products viewed
Search history
Similar products purchased by other customers
Customer profile information
The recommendation system operates automatically without manual review of
individual recommendations.
7. Marketing
DigitalCart sends promotional communications through:
Email
SMS
Push notifications
Customers may receive personalised promotions based on their customer
profile. Customers can unsubscribe from promotional email communications
through an unsubscribe link contained in marketing emails. SMS
communications can be disabled through the customer's account settings.
8. Data Retention
DigitalCart retains customer information for one year after the customer's last
interaction with the platform. The retention period currently applies to:
Account information
Purchase history
Browsing history
Search history
Customer profiles
Marketing segmentation information
Product recommendation information
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 

After the retention period

expires, the company intends to delete the customer's
information from its primary production databases. Backup systems may retain
historical copies for longer periods.
9. Data Sharing
DigitalCart uses several external service providers. These include:
Payment Provider: Used for processing customer payments.
Cloud Infrastructure Provider: Used for hosting application servers and
databases.
Email Provider: Used to deliver transactional and marketing emails.
Analytics Provider: Used to analyse website usage and customer
behaviour.
Marketing Platform: Used to manage customer segmentation and
promotional campaigns.
Customer information is shared with these providers where required for their
respective services.
10. Employee Access
Approximately 25 employees have access to customer information as part of
their job responsibilities. Employees include personnel from:
Customer support
Finance
Operations
Marketing
IT
Data analytics
Database administrators have access to the production database. Customer
support employees can access customer account and order information
through an internal customer management system. Marketing employees can
access customer segmentation information.
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
•

11. Security
The company currently implements the following security controls:
HTTPS/TLS
Password hashing
Username/password authentication
Role-based application access
Firewall protection
Database backups
Multi-factor authentication for administrators
Production environment access restrictions
Annual penetration testing
The primary production database is hosted in a cloud environment.
12. International Processing
Some of the company's technology and service providers operate infrastructure
outside the European Economic Area. The company may therefore transfer or
allow access to customer information from locations outside the EEA. The
company maintains contractual agreements with its s

ervice providers.
13. Customer Requests
Customers can contact the company through: privacy@digitalcart.example
Customers may use this channel to request information concerning their
personal data. The company manually processes these requests through its
privacy and customer-support teams. The company currently does not provide
a dedicated automated privacy portal.
14. Privacy Notice
14. Privacy Notice
Customers are provided with a privacy notice when creating an account.
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 

The notice describes:
Information collected
General purposes of processing
Use of cookies
Marketing communications
Customer rights
Contact information for privacy-related requests
The privacy notice is available through the website.
15. Automated Systems
DigitalCart uses automated systems for:
Product recommendations
Customer segmentation
Marketing personalisation
Fraud detection
Customer analytics
The customer segmentation system operates automatically using historical
customer behaviour.
16. Data Subject Rights
DigitalCart provides mechanisms for customers to:
Request access to their information
Request correction of inaccurate information
Request deletion of their account
Opt out of marketing communications
Requests are handled manually by the customer-support/privacy team.
17. Requested Assessment
DigitalCart Technologies Ltd. would like its GDPR compliance position
assessed based on the processing activities described above.

Data subject rights
Security requirements
Processor relationships
International data transfers
DPIA requirements
Required documentation
Recommended remediation actions
